title: AwACraft
description: A whitelisted community based SMP for those who want to join a small community that's built on trust!
body:
AwACraft is a public whitelist Minecraft community where players can live and strive together on a single SMP Server! Doing events, Modded server seasons, Vanilla seasons and much more!

Currently doing vanilla, Build your own base, your own shop, even your own minigames! Its a SMP after all, Treat it similar to what you might do in singleplayer while following the rules!

Current Plugins/Datapacks: AFK Display, CustomNetherportals, Voicechat

Currently on season 7! Server wiped 4/2/2026, Don't be afraid to join the discord for any questions or concerns!

We are a friendly community, everyone is amazing and kind, We like to help each other out when needed. We value each other's opinions and structure as we like to build off each other to grow more

Also have a creative server! Pre-plan your projects before building in the survival server! Axiom/Worldedit is installed

Server Location: United States Central
Website: discord.gg/kXuFZ7cHvr
Version: 26.X

How can you join? Join the discord below, and fill out a application, Got a question?Everything you should need is in the discord!

Theres a client side modpack that has the following list of mods here on modrinth!!
Mod list:
**Axiom:** Helps create terrain no matter the size of terrain
**BetterClouds:** Changes the look of the default clouds 
**Bundles Beyond:** Get a small window to see the items inside a bundle
**Chatheads:** Player heads now appear beside their usernames in chat
**Iris:** Allow shaders while using sodium
**Frecam:** A third party camera where you can fly around and view things at different angles
**Litematica:** A blueprint mod, copy a build from creative and have a blueprint in a different world
**Locator heads:** Replaces the dots on the locator bar to be player heads
**WorldEdit:** Helps you build with a lot of QOL features
**Voxy:** Lets you view things much farther away keeping the game optimized!
And 40+ more!
